_doc: Shared prompt text for AI image generation (tools/assets/pipeline.py generate). Every prompt is: preamble + category line + the spec's own prompt + constraints. Keep it in sync with docs/ART_BIBLE.md.
preamble: Original dark gothic fantasy pixel art sprite, slightly pixelated with strong dark outlines, detailed but readable at small size, ominous low-key lighting from the top left, muted desaturated palette with blood-red and ember accents. Dark fantasy, not cute and not cartoon horror.

categories.creature: Single full-body creature, three-quarter view facing right, standing on the ground, centred, whole silhouette visible.
categories.hero: Single mounted hero on the adventure map, three-quarter view facing right, centred.
categories.object: Single adventure-map object seen from a high three-quarter angle, centred.
categories.structure: Single fortified settlement seen from a high three-quarter angle, compact footprint, centred.
categories.icon: Single small inventory icon, centred, bold silhouette.
categories.ui: Flat UI frame texture, front view, no text.

constraints: Plain flat solid magenta (#ff00ff) background, no scenery, no text, no watermark, no border. Original design: do not imitate any existing game, franchise, logo or heraldry.
